name: Rainbow Bug Smash

userDirection: No hints; larger armoured ants need repeated taps; bosses have simple kid-friendly touch mechanics.

bosses.acorn: Tap three shiny acorn clasps, then tummy
bosses.bubble: Pop a bubble shield with real taps/swipes, then tummy
bosses.tickle: Actually rub the belly to fill its ring, then tummy
